Willett and Yu introduced a coarse invariance for metrics spaces, so called geometric property (T), which is an obstruction to the surjectivity of the maximal coarse Baum-Connes   assembly map. Roughly speaking, it is the existence of spectral gap for the Laplacian in the maximal Roe algebra associated with the space.
